lesson.subtitle: Lesson 15 -- My Flight Is Delayed: What You Need and What You Want
lesson.title_tag: Professor View -- Leão | Lesson 15 -- My Flight Is Delayed
lesson.grammar_point: need to and want to + verb

listenings.text: Good evening, passengers of flight IB six eight two seven to Madrid. We are sorry, but there is a delay of three hours. The new departure time is nine fifty. Passengers with a connection in Madrid tonight need to go to the counter at gate twenty to change it. Passengers with a connection tomorrow don't need to do anything. We have a voucher for dinner for every passenger. You can use it at the restaurant next to this gate. Boarding is at nine ten. Thank you for your patience.

Hi, love. Bad news. My flight is delayed, three hours, so I am in the airport until ten. Don't worry, my connection is tomorrow, so I don't need to change anything. But I need to call the hotel in Rome, because I want to arrive late tonight and I don't want to lose the room. I have a voucher for dinner, so I want to eat something now. And I need to find a charger, my phone is at ten percent. Tell the kids I want to talk to them tomorrow. Love you. Bye.

extra_audio.text: Hi. My flight is delayed. I need to call my hotel in Rome. Can I use a phone, please? Of course. And here is a voucher for dinner. Thank you. I want to eat something now.
